events.title: EMI / EMC Pre-Compliance Workshop 2026
events.organizer: BS Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology
events.description: EMI / EMC Pre-Compliance Workshop is a 1-Day Hands-on Industry Workshop organised by AIC–Crescent Innovation & Incubation Council (AIC–CIIC), designed to provide practical exposure to electromagnetic interference, electromagnetic compatibility and pre-compliance testing. The workshop focuses on identifying, analysing and mitigating EMI issues in emerging technology products, with practical applications covering Drone Antenna & RF Systems and EV BMS PCBs. Participants will gain hands-on exposure to RF interference, antenna coupling, GPS/GNSS, 2.4 / 5.8 GHz systems, switching noise, DC/DC converters, CAN systems, battery harnesses and common EMI sources. The workshop also introduces practical pre-compliance testing using equipment such as LISN, spectrum analyser, EMI probes, near-field scanning and ESD testing. The workshop follows a practical approach: Detect • Debug • Fix • Verify.
